newsitem.title: HONG KONG: OrientMet raises HK$114 mln in shr issue.
newsitem.headline: OrientMet raises HK$114 mln in shr issue.

text.p: Oriental Metals (Holdings) Co Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to place 56 million new shares at HK$2.10 per share with independent private investors, raising net proceeds of about HK$114 million for working capital.
The shares represent about 9.88 percent of Oriental Metals existing share capital and 8.99 percent of its enlarged share capital, the company said in a statement.
The placement is due to be completed on or before April 9.
Oriental Metal shares closed at HK$2.20 on Tuesday.
